plans.note: No liability article surfaced in the outline; this hosting/development agreement appears to lack any cap or carve-out structure. Confirm against the full text before proposing a mutual cap with standard carve-outs.

No indemnity provision appears in the outline. Expect to add HDI indemnity for third-party IP claims arising from the site and HDI misconduct, keeping our indemnity narrow (Deerskin Products content we supply).
No restrictive covenant section visible. Sweep the operative articles for any limit on the Company's ability to sell Deerskin Products through other channels or sites.
Nothing express in the outline, but hosting deals often bind the customer to a single host; check sec-1.4 (HDI's provision of access) and the surrounding services article for sole-source language.
No pricing or fees section surfaced, so no MFN either way. If a fee article exists in the full text, verify it does not oblige us to extend best terms to HDI.
Likely absent; sec-5.4 (each party appoints a project manager/representative) is the only personnel-facing provision and is the natural home if a no-hire of HDI staff were added.

"Termination Date" is a defined term, so a term/termination article exists outside the surfaced outline. Locate it and confirm we may terminate on notice without penalty and that HDI cannot exit mid-term.
The defined "Termination Date" suggests a fixed term rather than evergreen renewal; check the term article for any auto-extension and notice window before treating this as absent.

Miscellaneous provisions (notices are implied by the defined "Time of Receipt") sit between the operative articles and the signature block at sec-p0072; confirm the governing law/venue clause names an accepted jurisdiction such as New York or Delaware.

No assignment clause surfaced. Given HDI is an affiliated-group counterparty, check the miscellaneous article for assignment/change-of-control terms and ensure we may assign to affiliates and successors.

sec-1.4 covers HDI granting the Company access to site materials/data and is the closest hook for ownership; confirm the Company owns the site deliverables it pays for, plus all Deerskin Products content and customer data, with no assignment to HDI.
sec-1.4 is the access/licence grant; test scope for affiliate and contractor use and remove any at-will revocability or narrow internal-use-only wording.
No audit or records-inspection provision visible; sec-1.4's access mechanics are the only plausible location for HDI verification rights.
No fee, service-level or damages provision surfaced. Confirm there are no penalties or liquidated damages payable by the Company, and consider seeking service credits for hosting downtime.
No warranty or disclaimer section appears in the outline; expect to add an HDI performance warranty for the development work and hosting services with a re-performance remedy.

No insurance article surfaced even though HDI hosts our site and customer data; plan to add standard coverage (commercial general, tech E&O/cyber) or note the affiliate relationship as a possible carve-out.
No fees or volume-commitment provision in the outline; verify against the full text that the Company owes no minimum spend or take-or-pay for hosting or development hours.

No exit-assistance clause visible, though "Termination Date" and the sec-1.4 access rights give the hooks; plan to add return of Company data and site content plus reasonable migration help after termination.
